lines.en: I swing my tail in the shallows. Lightly.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼，身长不到一掌。
lines.en: A small fish. Less than a palm long.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，找软壳的。
lines.en: I swim along the sand, hunting soft shells.
The weeds part around me.

lines.zh: 顺着南极的水流走，省力。
lines.en: Riding the Antarctic current saves strength.
Cold water. Preferable.
Little bursts. My fins push the water.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子很小，是我。
lines.en: A small shadow on the surface. Me.
I pass. Marks left in the sand.

lines.zh: 南极的淡水里，我找小虫。
lines.en: In Antarctic fresh water, I hunt small bugs.

lines.zh: 早侏罗世的水，是这个味。
lines.en: Early Jurassic water. This is the taste.
I come near the bank. Insects there.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，不惊动大的。
lines.en: Low to the bottom. Don't disturb the big ones.

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，往前窜了一点。
lines.en: One tail beat. I shoot forward a little.

lines.zh: 水变浅了，我换了个方向。
lines.en: Getting shallow. I change direction.

lines.zh: 我找一处有虫落在水面的地方。
lines.en: Looking for a spot where insects land.
Not fast. The water's cold.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，挤过两块卵石。
lines.en: I turn on my side and squeeze between pebbles.
I stop among the weeds. Still.
Water through my gills. Pleasant.
Antarctica, back when it was warm.

lines.zh: 我看着水面上的光，看很久。
lines.en: I watch the light on the surface. Long.

lines.zh: 我这条鱼，个头实在不大。
lines.en: A fish this size. Not very big.

lines.zh: 有只大的游过去，我沉下去。
lines.en: Something big swam by. I sank.

lines.zh: 我悬在石缝上方，鳃慢慢开合。
lines.en: I hover above the crevice, gills opening slowly.

lines.zh: 我尾巴轻轻摆，保持位置。
lines.en: My tail moves just enough to stay put.

lines.zh: 我在水草根间找了个位置。
lines.en: I find a spot among the waterweed roots.
Waiting for an insect to land.

lines.zh: 我身上没什么颜色，很普通。
lines.en: Plain coloring. Ordinary.

lines.zh: 石头边上有一层藻，我不吃。
lines.en: Algae on the stone. I don't eat it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水流过背鳍。
lines.en: I turn sideways, letting current pass my dorsal fin.
A shadow on the bottom. Mine.
You're from the bank. Keep back.

lines.zh: 我从水下看着你，变形了。
lines.en: I see you through water. Distorted.

lines.zh: 你影子落在水面，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow on the surface. I see it.
This small. You can't see me well.
You put a foot in. Don't move.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，水动了一下。
lines.en: I tilt. The water stirs.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我贴着水皮瞧。
lines.en: You're on the bank; I watch from just under the surface.

lines.zh: 我游近一点，看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I come closer to see what you hold.

lines.zh: 你的手伸下来了，我退了。
lines.en: Your hand came down. I backed off.

lines.zh: 我们看着彼此，中间是一层水。
lines.en: We look at each other. Water between.
I darted off behind a stone.

lines.zh: 水一下浑了，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Water clouded. I can't see.

lines.zh: 我的薄身被撞得贴住石壁。
lines.en: My thin body is knocked against the stone wall.
Thin body. Touch hurts.
I sink to the bottom until you leave.

lines.zh: 南极的淡水里，我这么小一条。
lines.en: In Antarctic fresh water, a fish this small.
I circle, looking for direction.
I can't make a sound. Only swim.
Deeper now.
The water will mend it.
Insects! Dropped on the surface.

lines.zh: 我鼻子探出水面，又缩回去。
lines.en: My snout breaks the surface, then slips back.

lines.zh: 别晃手，我瞄准的是水面。
lines.en: Don't shake your hand; I aim at the surface.

lines.zh: 水面被搅动了，我看不清。
lines.en: The surface is disturbed. Can't see.
That's a day's food for me.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，南极的水一浑就看不见。
lines.en: Steady your hand; the Antarctic water clouds easily.
I don't bite people. Only insects.
It sank. I can't follow.

lines.zh: 我吞的时候，水也一起吞。
lines.en: I swallow water along with it.

lines.zh: 我身长不到一掌，只吃软壳的。
lines.en: Less than a hand long, I eat only soft shells.
Your foot touched me and I darted.
The water's cloudy now. Can't see.
This small. One touch does it.
I slip under the weeds.

lines.zh: 南极的淡水鱼，身量很小。
lines.en: An Antarctic freshwater fish, very small.
I swim circles around your feet.
You move and the ripples reach me.
I slip past the top of your boot.
Too much disturbance on the surface.
I didn't go far. Still close.
Not many of my kind. I'll look.

lines.zh: 我在水草间绕圈，那是求偶。
lines.en: Circling the weeds. That's courtship.
When the water warms.
The eggs go in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 你靠过来，我以为是大的。
lines.en: You came close. I took you for something big.
Our kind doesn't pair.
I sway my tail for you. That's all.

lines.zh: 南极的小鱼，也活过来了。
lines.en: A small Antarctic fish, alive again.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你在岸上，不行。
lines.en: I'm in the water, you're on land. No.
Don't put your hand in the weeds.
I take it. Can't swallow it.
Bigger than my mouth.
I nudge it with my mouth. It moves.
Debris on the bottom. I sift it.

lines.zh: 它在喉咙里，我甩了两下。
lines.en: It's stuck in my throat; I shake twice.
Not an insect. I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我衔着它，往那块青石游。
lines.en: I carry it toward that gray stone.
The water moved. I followed.
I drag it along.
It sank. I dive for it.

lines.zh: 你手指搅起的水纹传到我。
lines.en: The ripples from your fingers reach me.

lines.zh: 你的影子投下来，我停住。
lines.en: Your shadow falls; I hold still.
A small target. Just right.

lines.zh: 我升到浅处，鳍尖先出水。
lines.en: I rise to the shallows, fin tips first.

lines.zh: 那圈暗影里，有我要的东西。
lines.en: In that dark circle is what I want.

lines.zh: 南极的淡水鱼，鳍先张开。
lines.en: An Antarctic freshwater fish spreads its fins first.
You're on the bank. Out of reach.

lines.zh: 小虫落水，我一摆尾就上。
lines.en: An insect hits the water; one flick and I rise.

lines.zh: 水面那点亮，我认作食物。
lines.en: That glimmer on the surface I take for food.
I see better in this water than you.
I hug the bottom, following slowly.
You move. The ripples tell me.
I move beneath your shadow.
Waiting for it to fall again.
I blow a bubble. It rises.

lines.zh: 浅水对我不利，我慢慢来。
lines.en: Shallows are bad for me. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙底，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I creep along the sandy bottom, inch by inch.
My shadow in the water. Small.
I hold on the bottom until the ripples clear.
One more and I dart.
I dart up and nip.
Small bite. Well placed.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，水花溅到你脸上。
lines.en: I flick my tail. Water in your face.
You pulled your hand back. I retreated.
I bumped your finger.

lines.zh: 水里一乱，我就看不清了。
lines.en: The water's chaos. I can't see.

lines.zh: 我咬的还是虫子，不是你。
lines.en: I bit an insect, not you.
I turn and dive deep.
That startled me too.
I retreat into the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里出现，很小一条。
lines.en: I appear in the shallows. A small fish.
The surface stirred. That was me.
The water I was born in was cold.

lines.zh: 南极的淡水，我早游惯了。
lines.en: I have long swum Antarctic fresh water.
This pool suits. Not deep, not shallow.
I blow a string of bubbles.
The light on the water is new.
I circle first, to see the area.
There are insects to eat here.
Low over the sand. Slowly.

lines.zh: 一块石头下面，我游出来。
lines.en: Out from under a stone.
A tail flick. Getting used to the water.
The water turned hot. I darted up.
I hit the surface. Hard.

lines.zh: 我在水里，可这水没气了。
lines.en: I'm in water. This water has no air.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀到岸上。
lines.en: The water burst. I landed ashore.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过水，扎进我侧面。
lines.en: Something cut through the water into my flank.

lines.zh: 水里出现了我不懂的光。
lines.en: A light in the water I don't understand.

lines.zh: 水面上的虫子没了，我很饿。
lines.en: No insects on the surface. So hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，水里全是麻的。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water. Everything tingles.
No water. I'm falling through air.
